label: Deadline for City to appeal the Commission's findings
detail: City has said it will appeal. An appeal is heard by a three-member Appeal Board under Section W of the League's rules.

label: Sanction hearing
detail: The Commission decides the sanction at a further hearing, held in private. No date has been published.

label: Publication of the full decision and appendices
detail: Only a redacted Core Decision is public. The League says it will publish the appendices as soon as its rules allow.
